siteOptions.blogdescription: Preview and test the Holiday Mode for WooCommerce plugin.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
// WooCommerce-Grundeinstellungen
update_option('woocommerce_default_country', 'DE:DE-BW');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'EUR');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_allowed_countries', 'specific');
update_option('woocommerce_specific_allowed_countries', array('DE'));

// WooCommerce-Onboarding als abgeschlossen markieren
$profile = get_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array());
$profile['completed'] = true;
$profile['store_location'] = array(
    'country' => 'DE',
    'state'   => 'BW',
);
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', $profile);

update_option('woocommerce_setup_completed', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_admin_install_timestamp', time());
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_hidden', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_complete', array(
    'setup_store' => true,
));

// WooCommerce neu initialisieren
if ( function_exists('WC') ) {
    WC()->countries = new WC_Countries();
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// -------------------------------------------------
// Simple Product
// -------------------------------------------------
$simple = new WC_Product_Simple();
$simple->set_name('Simple Product');
$simple->set_status('publish');
$simple->set_regular_price('1');
$simple->save();

// -------------------------------------------------
// Variable Product
// -------------------------------------------------
$attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
$attribute->set_id(0);
$attribute->set_name('Variation');
$attribute->set_options(array('A'));
$attribute->set_visible(true);
$attribute->set_variation(true);

$variable = new WC_Product_Variable();
$variable->set_name('Variable Product');
$variable->set_status('publish');
$variable->set_attributes(array($attribute));
$variable_id = $variable->save();

// Variante A
$variation = new WC_Product_Variation();
$variation->set_parent_id($variable_id);
$variation->set_attributes(array(
    'Variation' => 'A',
));
$variation->set_regular_price('1');
$variation->set_status('publish');
$variation->save();

// Cache aktualisieren
WC_Product_Variable::sync($variable_id);
wc_delete_product_transients($variable_id);

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option('hmfw_holiday_message', 'Our shop is currently in holiday mode. Orders are temporarily disabled.');
update_option('hmfw_holiday_status', 'yes');
update_option('hmfw_holiday_startdate', '2026-01-01');
update_option('hmfw_holiday_enddate', '2099-01-01');
